title: Hourly battery health per vehicle (Parquet)
description: Hourly tumbling-window aggregates of battery_sample events from vehicle.battery.health.v1, one row per (vin, window_start) with at least one sample. Windows are aligned to the UTC hour. Not a Kafka topic: written as Parquet to x-sink, partitioned by date, so the Kafka annotations are null. All derivations are in event time and use inputs only: deduplicate by event_id first, ignore arrival order, never read a processing-time clock. Input lateness is at most 300 seconds, so jobs must allow at least 300 seconds of lateness and drop nothing. HALF_UP rounding means: round to the nearest value at the stated scale, ties away from zero, computed on exact decimal values (integer arithmetic), never on binary floating point.

date.description: UTC date of window_start. Partition column.

window_start.description: Start of the UTC hour, inclusive.

sample_count.description: Distinct battery_sample event_ids in the window.

soh_pct_avg.description: HALF_UP(sum of soh_pct in hundredths / sample_count) / 100. Example: samples 95.01 and 95.02 sum to 19003 hundredths; 19003 / 2 = 9501.5, which rounds to 9502, so the value is 95.02.
